Capital One announced it will acquire Brex for $5.15 billion, bringing one of the most prominent fintech platforms under the umbrella of a major U.S. bank.
The deal combines Brex’s corporate card and software platform with Capital One’s scale and infrastructure, and it comes just a year after Capital One’s $35 billion acquisition of Discover.

...

## Deal highlights: What you need to know
* Value: $5.15 billion ($2.75 billion in cash, plus [10.6 million Capital One shares](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/927628/000119312526019543/d97758d8k.htm#:~:text=Pursuant%20to%20the%20terms%20and,%E2%80%9CCompany%20Common%20Stock%E2%80%9D).) ).

...

* Timeline: The deal is expected to close in the second quarter of 2026, according to [The Wall Street Journal](https://www.wsj.com/finance/banking/capital-one-to-buy-fintech-brex-e2dacc67)
* Leadership: Brex co-founder and CEO Pedro Franceschi will continue leading the platform post-acquisition

...

## How the fintech market is shifting
* Independent platforms (Ramp, Rho, Navan)
* Bank-owned fintechs (Brex via Capital One, [Center via American Express](https://ir.americanexpress.com/news/investor-relations-news/investor-relations-news-details/2025/American-Express-Completes-Acquisition-of-Center/default.aspx) )

...

## FAQs
### Is Brex being acquired?
Yes. Capital One announced on January 22, 2026, that it will acquire Brex in a deal valued at approximately $5.15 billion.

### Who is acquiring Brex?
Capital One Financial, a major U.S. bank and credit card issuer.

### When will the Capital One Brex acquisition close?
The deal is expected to close in mid-2026, subject to regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions.
